po

A native, chat-driven AI harness. Local-first inference, append-only sessions, tool approvals — one state machine under all of it.

GitHub Quick start

Chat-driven

Slash commands, cmd-k palette, and buttons all dispatch the same events into one explicit agent state machine.

Local-first

The nano-ai engine runs MiniCPM-V in-process on Apple Silicon; echo and OpenAI-compatible endpoints fill in everywhere else.

Replayable

Sessions are append-only JSONL logs — switch reloads from disk, fork writes a branch, replay is deterministic.
